i.norm: Tests {@link EnumUtils#processBitVector(Class, long)} when the enum cannot be represented as a {@code long} bit vector.

{@code processBitVector} stores each enum constant in a single bit of a {@code long}, so it supports at most {@link Long#SIZE} (64) constants. {@code TooMany} declares 65 constants, which exceeds that limit and must be rejected with an {@link IllegalArgumentException}, regardless of the bit-vector value supplied.
